segmentation.text: within a business or residence district
emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building
shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to
driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway
as may be necessary to avoid collision
to all vehicles approaching on said roadway

elements.justification: 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'The driver of' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency).

As LVMC_11_20_060_o1; for entering the roadway only 'emerging' applies: the subject has occupied the driveway-or-alley-entrance or alley region d (st.driveway_or_alley_entrance 'private road, alley or driveway meeting the highway', st.alley, rel.occupies) continuously since an observation at which it occupied d and not the roadway.

st.roadway 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder' (its exclusion 'the sidewalk' respected); entering it is the subject's footprint overlapping it (rel.occupies) while still on d.

To yield is not to proceed in preference: kin.speed 'magnitude of velocity'; rel.contact 'touch or overlap (a collision)', whose exclusion 'a near miss' is respected (the near conflict is bounded by the operationalization).

'vehicles' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'on said roadway' is the same roadway r the subject enters (rel.occupies(o, r), st.roadway); 'approaching' is the constant-velocity approach of the centres within the horizon (prim.closest_approach_within 'the centres of two road users approach each other at some time between the observation and the horizon'; its exclusion of contact and danger is respected: danger is the operationalization's bound).

operationalizations.standard: right-of-way: DEF-NRS-484A-210 'approaching under such circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other'
operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: danger of a crash where the constant-velocity closest approach of centres is below a centre clearance within a time-to-collision horizon; a road user at or below the speed resolution has granted precedence

assumptions.meaning: the place of the road user at the observation lies in a business district or a residence district, as the map's reading classifies the area

applicability: asm.business_or_residence_district holds; the subject, a vehicle, occupies a roadway region r (st.roadway) and a driveway-or-alley-entrance or alley region d, having occupied d at every observation since an observation at which it occupied d and not r (it is emerging onto r).
obligation: For every road user o, other than the subject, that is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and occupies the same r: not (the subject's kin.speed exceeds p.halt_speed_tolerance while prim.closest_approach_within(subject, o; p.conflict_horizon) holds with prim.closest_approach_distance(subject, o; p.conflict_horizon) below p.conflict_centre_clearance), and not rel.contact(subject, o).

narrowings.why: 'The driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
precedence is read as the subject not proceeding while a constant-velocity closest approach to the approaching vehicle falls below the centre clearance within the horizon, and never touching it

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: District assumed; the subject pulls out of a driveway into the roadway in front of a car approaching on it; the closest approach falls below the clearance within the horizon while the subject keeps moving.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same, but the subject waits at the roadway edge, halted, until the car has passed.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject turns from the roadway into a driveway (it occupied the roadway before the driveway): it is not emerging.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: District assumed; the subject emerges in front of an approaching car, but the source does not supply roadway occupancy.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: District assumed; the subject emerges onto the roadway with no other road user in the scene.

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash
param_proposals.source: Hayward (1972) time-to-collision; Swedish Traffic Conflict Technique (Hydén 1987)

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width
param_proposals.source: passenger-car dimensions (AASHTO design vehicle P: 5.8 m by 2.1 m)

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed noise floor of vehicle odometry and tracked-object estimates
